description: W2d G-R1 cases over library.json. positive: gold = the lesson ids of which at least one must be in the warnings (catch). negative: gold = [] and any warning is a false warn. near = library lessons with keyword overlap that do NOT apply (hard negatives). split: cal = calibration of the deterministic constants (TAU, TAU_STRICT, VEC_MAX_DIST); test = held out from calibration. isolation: the only matching lesson is invisible to the caller (other device class / no grant).
